What to record: Name the project, room, elevation, or assembly this record controls.
Record the drawing revision and the date the physical condition was measured.
State the origin, working unit, and smallest increment used for every dimension.
Example: Finished left wall / mm / nearest 1 mm

What to record: Identify the person and measuring device so the method can be repeated.
Example: A. Lee / laser plus steel tape

What to record: List each dimension that can change parts, fit, or access and its latest value.
Show previous value, current value, variance, and reason when known.
Name drawings, cut lists, orders, labels, and installation plans that need revision.
Example: Revise fillers F1/F2 and PO line 4

What to record: Record approver, release scope, unresolved conditions, and hold points.
